issue.title: test_stop_live_inline_run_settles_stop_requested hits 'tool run store is busy: database is locked' under the full lane, passes in isolation
issue.description: Load-sensitive ToolRun store lock contention in tests/tool/test_lifecycle_controls.py; see the flake report.

task_type_fields.evidence: Proposed by sase-18f.3 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP #4, epic sase-18f green-check). In a full `just test` lane on clean master (2026-09-24) the node failed with `tool run store is busy: database is locked`; it then passed 3/3 in isolation on the unchanged tree (~3.9s each). Fail rate: 1 full-lane failure, 0/3 serial. The failure is SQLite busy contention on the ToolRun store under full-suite load, not a deterministic defect; the precise lock holder was not identified, so no narrower size is claimed.

evidence.note: Corroboration relayed by sase-18j.land from sase-18j.7 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP #4, 2026-09-25T20:24Z): tests/tool/test_settlement.py::test_handoff_end_to_end_publishes_one_notification failed with 'tool run store is busy' under wide parallel load during sase-18j.7's known-gated-continuation verification. It passed alone. The test is an ad-hoc handoff run (sh -c 'exit 0'), so E3's settle-time triage does not run for it. That points to the same launcher-poll vs worker-settle SQLite busy window, not a triage write.

Independent reproduction during sase-1fv.3 just check ToolRun 365b549936c4d536882c8c730b49b981 (2026-10-04, 14-worker scoped lane, concurrent sase_16 check): FAILED tests/tool/test_detach.py::test_watchdog_reports_ended_join_monitor with RuntimeError: tool run store is busy: database is locked. Isolation pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider on the same tree passed (6.00s call). Same SQLite busy contention, different node. This phase did not touch detach/tool-run store.
